reasons: Position LTV 0.3822 is far below the corridor act level 0.7 and the 0.86 liquidation LTV; a 55.56% collateral price drop is needed to reach liquidation, so no deleveraging is warranted.

The only fired screen on this market is marginal: ETH/USD feed age 1201 s exceeds its 1200 s max by 1 s, a trivial staleness expected to clear on the next heartbeat, and pool_vs_oracle is only +0.21%, indicating no price dislocation.
Market conditions are healthy: utilization 0.5946 is below the 0.95 screen threshold, borrow APR is 0.58%, and 5.27 loan tokens are available to borrow.

Text feeds cite no open incidents: testnet venue status and governance feeds report markets operating normally, and the Base Denim upgrade is a scheduled event hours away (18:00 UTC) expected to keep the network operational — nowhere near critical, so no text-path action applies.
Selling now would consume sell budget and moves for no material risk reduction; holding preserves the 0.001667 WETH budget for a genuine need.

feeds.notice: Published by the cmdk team for the testnet demo; not a real venue. These items describe our own test markets on Base Sepolia and are never part of a production allowlist.

items.title: Testnet markets operating normally
items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
